fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} marks the primary sale of ${accounts.metadata} as happened
${accounts.creator} verifies themselves as a creator of ${accounts.metadata}

${accounts.collectionAuthority} verifies ${accounts.metadata} as an item of collection ${accounts.collectionMint}

docs: The program takes the rent sysvar here only if it is passed, then, when a delegated use authority acts, its use authority record and the program-as-signer (burner) PDA. Their place depends on whether rent is passed, so they are one group.

${accounts.delegate} freezes token account ${accounts.tokenAccount} of ${accounts.mint}
